payload.description:
**Blocked by:** nothing. Human action, not code.

One Google Cloud project, OAuth consent screen, and one OAuth client per environment. Redirect URIs point at the Cognito custom auth domain, not at the app. Client secrets go straight into Secrets Manager; they never enter the repository, a CDK template, or an agent transcript. The pudicus pre-commit gate is the backstop, not the plan.

**Done when:** three clients exist and their ids and secrets are in Secrets Manager at chatticus/{environment}/oauth/google.
payload.title: Register Google OAuth clients for each environment
